units.source_text: “真一，”千重子对喜欢侃侃而谈的真一说，

en.t: "Shinichi," Chieko said to the talkative Shinichi,

units.source_text: “时代节那天你看到在御所庭园里的那一对，不是我，你看错人啦。

en.t: "That pair you saw in the palace garden on the day of the Jidai Festival was not me. You mistook me for someone else.
You saw them from far away, didn't you?"
